title: European hotel network
description: Four geolocated hotels and 88 rooms across the complete October–December 2026 quarter, with daily room-type selling quotes, generated event fixtures and hotel-specific relevance assessments. EUR amounts exclude VAT. Selling quotes remain separate from accepted booking revenue. Past actuals, scheduled occupancy, on-the-books revenue and planned expenses remain explicit.

reportingPeriods.description: October, November and December 2026, each with a complete calendar range.

dailyRoomStates.description: Every physical room on every date in the quarter, including vacant and out-of-service dates.

dailyCosts.description: Daily actual and planned expenses. The monthly cost ledger is an exact grouping of these rows.

dailyChannels.description: All four channels on every hotel stay date, reconciled to the accepted room-night ledger.

reservationNights.description: Complete accepted stay-night ledger. Each room/date can appear only once.

dailyFacilityActivity.description: Every facility on every quarter date, including zero-use days. Actual and planned activity remain separate.

hotels.description: The four hotel properties, including their WGS84 locations.

events.description: Generated ongoing and upcoming event fixtures with venue coordinates, inclusive dates and illustrative attendance. Not live or verified event listings.

eventHotelImpacts.description: Normalized hotel-event relevance assessments, with distance, importance, rationale and explicit provenance. Events can influence more than one hotel without duplicating event records.

roomTypes.description: Physical inventory, capacity, reference rates and common facilities.

roomRates.description: One selling quote for each room type and quarter date. Current local updates override quotes; accepted reservations retain their booked rates.

rooms.description: All 88 physical rooms and their November 14 operational snapshot, derived from daily states.

facilities.description: Property services, capacities, local hours and guest fees.

restaurants.description: Three full-service outlets. Porto has a breakfast lounge instead.

costs.description: Monthly operating expenses grouped by hotel, category, department and actual/planned basis.

unitCosts.description: Planning reference costs per operational unit.

channels.description: Monthly room nights, room revenue and acquisition fees, separated into actual and on-the-books groups.

dailyPerformance.description: One row per hotel for all 92 quarter dates. Room revenue reconciles to accepted nights; facility revenues reconcile to activity.

reservations.description: Complete one-to-four-night stays across the quarter, with excluded reservations retained for workflow and prior-snapshot reconstruction.

bookingPositions.description: All quarter stay-date actuals and current/prior confirmed booking aggregates, captured as of November 14.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees, from -90 to 90.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180.

key.description: Selected reporting month, YYYY-MM, within the covered quarter.

roomTypeId.description: RoomType.id foreign key within the same hotel.

date.description: Quoted stay date; unique with roomTypeId across the full covered quarter.

nightlyRate.description: Selling quote per room per night in EUR excluding VAT, rounded to cents. Independent of booked reservation revenue and event relevance.

occupancy.description: Occupied, available, or excluded from sellable inventory.

housekeeping.description: Housekeeping state for this stay date.

maintenance.description: Open maintenance blocks the room from sale.

maintenanceNote.description: Work description for open maintenance; otherwise null.

basis.description: Completed actual state before asOf; scheduled state today and later.

description.description: What this expense includes, to prevent double counting.

basis.description: Completed actual expense or planned expense for today and later.

date.description: Operating expense date, including zero-volume days.

soldNights.description: Accepted room nights in this channel group.

grossRevenue.description: Room revenue before acquisition costs, excluding VAT.

acquisitionCost.description: Acquisition cost; monthly groups sum the individually rounded daily fees.

basis.description: Completed actual room revenue or provisional on-the-books revenue.

date.description: Stay date, unique with hotelId and channel.

roomId.description: Assigned Room.id; unique with date across accepted reservations.

date.description: Occupied stay date, inside the reservation arrival/departure range.

channel.description: Must match the parent reservation channel.

roomRevenue.description: Accepted nightly room revenue; sums exactly to the reservation value.

facilityId.description: Facility.id foreign key within the same hotel.

uses.description: Daily people, covers, room uses, parking nights, or hours, according to facility kind.

revenue.description: Daily facility revenue in EUR, excluding VAT.

basis.description: Completed activity before asOf; planned activity today and later.

currency.description: Currency for every amount in this dataset.

reportingPeriod.description: Full quarter coverage: October 1 through December 31, 2026, including actual and planned rows.

snapshotDate.description: Date represented by room and reservation operational states.

previousAsOf.description: Prior booking snapshot date, seven days before asOf.

days.description: Number of stay dates in the quarter.

period.description: Full quarter stay-date coverage; each UI month selects a complete calendar slice.

source.description: Aggregated positions reconciled to the complete accepted reservation-night ledger.

includedOnBooksStatuses.description: Reservation states included in current and prior on-the-books aggregates.

notes.description: Stay-date, current-day, pickup, target and accounting semantics.

stayDate.description: Date of the room night; unique with hotelId.

capturedAsOf.description: Business date of this fixed booking snapshot.

state.description: Position relative to the booking snapshot business date.

roomsAvailable.description: Sellable physical room-night capacity for this stay date.

actualRooms.description: Completed sold room nights for past dates only; null for today and future.

actualRoomRevenue.description: Completed past stay-date room revenue, EUR net of VAT; null for today and future.

roomsOnBooks.description: Confirmed/checked-in room nights for today and future only; null for completed dates.

revenueOnBooks.description: Current confirmed/checked-in room revenue by stay date; not realized revenue or a forecast.

roomsOnBooks7dAgo.description: On-the-books room nights for this same stay date at previousAsOf; null for past stay dates.

revenueOnBooks7dAgo.description: On-the-books revenue for this same stay date at previousAsOf; null for past stay dates.

pickup7dRoomNights.description: Signed roomsOnBooks minus roomsOnBooks7dAgo; null for completed dates.

pickup7dRevenue.description: Signed revenueOnBooks minus revenueOnBooks7dAgo, in EUR; null for completed dates.

targetRooms.description: Planned sold room nights for the stay date, not above roomsAvailable.

targetRevenue.description: Planned room revenue for the stay date, EUR net of VAT. Not expected sales.

line1.description: Configured street and building; fixture values are sample addresses, not verified hotel locations.

postalCode.description: Configured postal code, with no claim of independent address verification.

coordinates.description: Hotel location in WGS84 decimal degrees: latitude -90 to 90, longitude -180 to 180.

address.description: Optional configured postal address with line1, optional line2 and postalCode. City and country belong to the hotel. Fixture addresses are sample data and coordinates are not geocoded matches.

id.description: Unique event identifier, shared by every related hotel assessment.

name.description: Generated event name; not a verified live event listing.

endDate.description: Last event date, inclusive; not before startDate.

venue.description: Venue used by the generated event.

coordinates.description: Venue location in WGS84 decimal degrees: latitude -90 to 90, longitude -180 to 180.

expectedAttendance.description: Illustrative expected attendance, not measured attendance.

eventId.description: HotelEvent.id foreign key; unique with hotelId.

importance.description: Hotel-specific assessment considering proximity and event relevance; not a demand forecast.

distanceKm.description: Straight-line Haversine distance from hotel to venue, using Earth radius 6371 km, rounded to two decimals. Not a road distance.

reason.description: Explanation of this hotel-specific relevance assessment.

source.description: Assessment provenance. Seeded records use fixture; kassandra is reserved for a future assistant assessment.

assessedAt.description: Date this assessment was made, no later than the fixed business date.

inventory.description: Number of physical rooms of this type.

areaM2.description: Approximate room area in square metres.

baseRate.description: Reference nightly room rate, EUR net of VAT. Actual daily rates vary.

facilities.description: Facilities shared by every room in this room type.

roomTypeId.description: RoomType.id foreign key within the same hotel.

number.description: Room number, unique within a hotel.

date.description: Current room-state snapshot date, derived from dailyRoomStates.

basis.description: Current state basis, using the same calendar boundary as daily room states.

housekeeping.description: Snapshot housekeeping state, independent of occupancy.

maintenanceNote.description: Short work description when maintenance is open, otherwise null.

capacity.description: People or spaces, as appropriate; null when not capacity-limited.

openingHours.description: Local opening hours, including service windows.

fee.description: Published reference guest fee, EUR net of VAT.

feeUnit.description: Basis of the listed guest fee; included means zero fee.

id.description: Unique restaurant identifier, also the matching restaurant Facility.id.

openingHours.description: Local breakfast, lunch and dinner service windows.

breakfastPrice.description: Breakfast selling price per person, EUR net of VAT.

averageCheck.description: Average lunch/dinner spend per cover, excluding breakfast.

description.description: What this expense includes, to prevent double counting.

basis.description: Completed actual expense or planned expense for today and later.

period.description: Selected reporting month, YYYY-MM, within the covered quarter.

basis.description: Physical unit used by the planning rate.

amount.description: Planning cost per unit, EUR net of VAT.

description.description: Scope of the planning cost. Not an extra ledger expense.

soldNights.description: Accepted room nights in this channel group.

grossRevenue.description: Room revenue before acquisition costs, excluding VAT.

acquisitionCost.description: Acquisition cost; monthly groups sum the individually rounded daily fees.

basis.description: Completed actual room revenue or provisional on-the-books revenue.

period.description: Selected reporting month, YYYY-MM, within the covered quarter.

roomsAvailable.description: Sellable physical rooms that day, after out-of-service exclusions.

soldNights.description: Sold room nights for the day, at most roomsAvailable.

roomRevenue.description: Daily room revenue, before acquisition costs and net of VAT.

restaurantRevenue.description: All restaurant service revenue, including breakfast; zero where no restaurant exists.

restaurantCovers.description: All restaurant service covers; zero where no restaurant exists.

otherRevenue.description: Revenue from all non-restaurant facilities, including the Porto breakfast lounge.

budgetSoldNights.description: Planned room nights, at most roomsAvailable.

budgetRoomRevenue.description: Planned room revenue, net of VAT.

basis.description: Completed room revenue before asOf; on-the-books room revenue today and later.

ancillaryBasis.description: Completed restaurant/other activity before asOf; planned activity today and later.

roomTypeId.description: RoomType.id foreign key in the same hotel.

roomId.description: Assigned Room.id in the same hotel and room type; null when unassigned.

status.description: Reservation workflow state at the snapshot date.

departure.description: Departure date, exclusive and after arrival.

adults.description: Number of adults, within the room-type capacity.

children.description: Number of children, within the room-type capacity.

roomRevenue.description: Accepted stay value, exactly equal to reservationNights; zero for cancelled, no-show and pending records.

bookedOn.description: Creation date used to reconstruct prior on-the-books positions.

cancelledOn.description: Cancellation date; null when no cancellation has occurred.

quotedNightlyRate.description: Quoted room-night rate, including the historical quote on an excluded reservation.

quotedRevenue.description: Quoted full stay value before any cancellation; preserves prior-snapshot value.
